name: 83844 · Moscow, ID
findings: ZIP 83844 (Moscow) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (69%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83844 (Moscow) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
100% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
